# vodoo activity

Manage Odoo activities (`mail.activity`).

<!-- This file is auto-generated by scripts/gen_cli_docs.py. Do not edit manually. -->

## Commands

### list

List activities.

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--model` | TEXT | Filter by related model (e.g. account.move) |
| `--user` | TEXT | Filter by assigned user name |
| `--type` | TEXT | Filter by activity type name |
| `--limit` | INT | Maximum number of activities (default: 50) |
| `--field` / `-f` | TEXT | Specific fields to fetch (can be used multiple times) |

### show

Show detailed activity information.

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `activity_id` | INT | Activity ID |

**Options:**

| Option | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `--field` / `-f` | TEXT | Specific fields to fetch (can be used multiple times) |

### done

Mark an activity as done.

**Arguments:**

| Argument | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `activity_id` | INT | Activity ID |
